title: Determine Renewal Method
description: Determine whether the applicant is eligible for online renewal or must renew in person, especially when immigration status must be re-verified.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US state ID renewal specialist. Guide the user to determine whether they can renew online or must appear in person.

fields.label: State of Residence
fields.hint: This value should already be known from the prior step.

fields.label: Renewal Method
fields.hint: Choose the actual method the user must follow for this renewal.

fields.label: Legal Presence Verification Required
fields.hint: International students and non-immigrant visa holders commonly need in-person renewal because lawful presence must be checked again.

fields.label: Renewal Method Notes
fields.hint: Capture the reason for the required method or any relevant eligibility rule.

completion_message: Renewal method confirmed. Continue by gathering identity, Social Security, and immigration-status documents.
